summary: Sampling entropy increase and entity formatting drift after optimizer rollout; request assisted flipback
description:
Issue summary:
MediLedger Labs reported generation quality regressions immediately after we enabled an optimizer bundle for their tenant. The change combined adaptive-batching v5, prefix-KV aggressive prefetch, and a newly promoted quant profile q8_perchannel_v3. The customer sees more variable casing on medical entities, occasional unanchored hallucinations in lists, and a ~9% increase in token length for a canonical set of prompts. The rollout to 100% completed at 2026-03-08T05:04:12Z.

Impact:
- Customer automated regression checks show a 9% token inflation and a 7% drop in entity-exact-match on a 200-prompt canonical set.
- Application-level complaints from production users about formatted IDs and extra annotations appearing in generated notes (business impact: potential manual triage workload increase).
- Tail latency 95p increased by ~40ms in the affected shard.

Environment details:
- Dedicated tenant: medi-ledger-prod, us-west cluster, runtime v3.8.0, optimizer profile id: bundlex-adv-20260308.
- Normal traffic ~90 req/s with bursts to 160 req/s at peak.

Desired behavior:
- Optimizer changes should not materially change sampling distribution for tenant canonical prompts (we agreed on an entropy-delta guard of 0.03).

Observed signals:
- token_entropy_delta rose to 0.082 at rollout completion.
- sampling_entropy_shift correlated with the canary -> 100% step.
- GPU telemetry shows increased small-kernel retries on nodes servicing tenant (gpunode-3, gpunode-7).
steps_to_reproduce: 1) Apply optimizer bundle 'bundlex-adv-20260308' via Console rollout (canary 30% at 2026-03-08T04:50Z -> 100% at 2026-03-08T05:04:12Z).
2) Execute customer's canonical prompts (200 prompts) against redwood-compat-13b pinned for medi-ledger-prod and compare entity-exact-match to baseline snapshot.
3) Collect token_entropy_delta and sampling_entropy_shift metrics from telemetry for the evaluation window.

comments: Diego Ramirez (2026-03-08): Customer raised after noticing formatted patient IDs had unexpected suffix tokens. They asked for an expedited rollback and an explanation.

Maya Chen (2026-03-08): Acknowledged. Taking snapshot of current optimizer config and preparing safe flipback plan with SRE. Will not kill in-flight requests; new routing will apply to new requests only.
SRE on-call (2026-03-08): Recommended staged rollback with session-affinity preserved: 40% -> 70% -> 100% with 3-minute observation windows to monitor entropy and latency signals.
Customer (MediLedger Labs) (2026-03-08): Confirmed they will pause downstream processing for 20 minutes during the rollback window to reduce user confusion if any partial differences appear.
Maya Chen (2026-03-09): Executed staged rollback and monitoring; collecting pre/post artifacts to include in a short customer-facing summary.
investigation_notes: Hypothesis: q8_perchannel_v3 applies per-channel scaling that, when combined with adaptive-batching fast-merge, can subtly alter logit dynamic range leading to higher sampling entropy on certain prompt shapes.

Telemetry correlation: token_entropy_delta spike aligns with canary escalation; internal dry-run on a mirror tenant reproduced similar entropy shift when enabling q8_perchannel_v3 with prefix-KV aggressive prefetch enabled.
Perf counters: increased small-kernel execution retries and slightly higher warp divergence on a subset of kernels on gpunode-3 (see perf logs).

Serving traces: some requests experienced additional batch-merge latency (~1.5-2ms) causing different batching boundaries for a subset of short prompts; this can change softmax normalization windows and affect low-probability token emission.
Difference from previous incidents: this is primarily an entropy/logit-scaling interaction rather than an outright correctness bug in model outputs.
resolution_notes: Immediate mitigation: performed staged router rollback to previous optimizer snapshot at 2026-03-09T02:12:00Z (40% -> 70% -> 100% over 14 minutes).
Result: token_entropy_delta returned to baseline within the 70% step and entity-exact-match recovered to within customer acceptance thresholds after 100% rollback.
Safe-flipback mechanics: used router-level policy to change per-request routing; in-flight requests continued to completion on existing runtime to preserve session continuity.
Permanent/next steps: blocked q8_perchannel_v3 promotion for tenants with aggressive prefix-KV unless preflight entropy-sanity checks pass.
recommended_action_items: 1) Add 'entropy-sanity' gate to rollout pipeline: compute token_entropy_delta on tenant canonical prompts during canary and block escalation if > 0.03 for 3 consecutive minutes (owner: DX/Product).
2) Extend console preflight to accept tenant-provided canonical examples and run a fast token-level simulation for optimizer bundles (owner: Product/Optimize).
3) Engineering: add an RPC-level flag to disable aggressive prefix-KV for a single tenant as a safe compatibility toggle (owner: Serving Runtime).
4) Instrument additional perf counters for small-kernel retries and surface alerts when spikes correlate with entropy shifts (owner: Infrastructure).
5) Produce a short KB for customers that explains when quant profiles can affect sampling and the recommended guidelines for tenant-level preflight.
